verse: na lekhyaṃ lekhanīyaṃ vā na ca jāpāntaraṃ kvacit | na śuddhaṃ na ca vāśuddhaṃ na śāktaṃ na ca śāṃbhavam
dṛṣṭaṃ me adbhutaṃ devi sarvasaṃhārakārakam ||2/5 ||
śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇu bhairava tattvena praśnaṃ tu paramārthataḥ | aṣṭa pīṭhāstu ye proktāḥ sarvapīṭheṣu cottamāḥ
śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇu vīra pravakṣyāmi savitrīkramaśāsanam | yayā vijñātamātrayā kramajñānaṃ bhaved dhruvam
sthiti navamavarṇena śilayā lāṃcchitaṃ kuru | etat piṇḍākṣaraṃ rudra ādau tasmāt samuddharet
sṛṣṭicakrasya ādau tu ṣoḍaśāni samāsataḥ | varṇāni kālakāmāntu pūrvādīśānaka kramāt
pañcaprakārametaddhi vijñāyet tattvadarśinaḥ | kramaṃ tu devadeveśa āgataṃ kramayogataḥ
bhavate sarvasattvānāṃ tad vadasva vidhānataḥ | śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā kramasārasya nirṇayam
jñātavyāḥ sarvathā nātha aśarīrāccharīragāḥ | etāstu mūrtayaḥ proktāḥ khecakrapadadarśikāḥ
kathitaṃ tava deveśa pāramparyakramāgatam | śrībhairava uvāca tvatprasādena vai bhadre ṣoḍaśaca yathārthataḥ
nirdvayā acyutā śāntā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | pakṣadvayavinirmuktā madhyamāpādamadhyagā
etāstu * *? tā devyaḥ sarvagrasanalampaṭāḥ | catvāra urmayo devyāḥ śāṃbhavyudadhimadhyagāḥ
kathayāmi samāsena ambarāsvararūpiṇīm | yasya vijñātamātreṇa sa sthitijño bhaved dhruvam
kalpānte kāladehasya carvaṇe lālasā sadā | ūrdhvamārge ca sā kālī dvādaśāntāntarūpagā
sarvamantrāraṇī yā vai mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | etāstu mantrasiddhā vai bhūmayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ
etat sarvaṃ * * * * kathayasva tu nirṇayam] | vada me parameśāni sārāt sārataraṃ param
na lekhyāni ca bodhātmā na vadet sarvamadhyataḥ | na pāṭhaṃ teṣu nāmeṣu kartavyaṃ vācayā hara
ṣoḍaśānāṃ tu yad  jñeyaṃ jñānarūpaṃ parāparam ||2/26 ||
mukhyaṃtu sarvavidyānāṃ sarvasānnirmukārakam | sṛṣṭirūpaṃ sthitisthaṃ ca saṃhārakaraṇodyatam
nutvā khacakramādyakaṃ kālākhyaṃ satatoditam | pūjayāmi yathānyāyaṃ devyāṃ saṃhārakālikām
īśvarakathitaṃ rudra sthiticakraṃ vidhānataḥ | sarvabhāvesu sāmānyaṃ sarvadoṣaistuvarjiam
śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇu rudra pravakṣyāmi vidyāṃ teṣāṃ yathā sthitām | siddhānāṃ yoginīnāṃ ca sthiticakrasvarūpagā
khatvāṅgaistu mahākādyairmuṇḍaistu  parivāritam ||2/4 ||
yogināṃ svātma niṣṭānāṃ bodhitvā samatāṃ sakṛt | sphurate yā akrāmena sā sṛṣṭiḥ sarvatomukhī
sārabhūtaṃ kramārthasya mantroddhāramidaṃ param | yena vijñātamātreṇa mantrāmantravido bhavet
sarvamantra-ārṇavaṃ guhyaṃ sarvavidyālayaṃ param | asya cakreśvarasyaiva sakṛt paśyati yo naraḥ
vāgbhavaṃ tu tato yojyaṃ kāmarājaṃ tatoddharet | sthitisthaṃ tu tato rudra dvitīyaṃ viśvarūpakam
pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena gurubhaktena kramagāḥ | tāsāṃ tu yoginīnāṃ ca pāraṃparyagatāni ca
vaktrād vaktragataṃ vyaktaṃ avyaktaṃ cakramadhyagam | tena cakrena vakṣyāmi vaktrāmnāyaṃ kramāyatam
nirāvakāśa śabdantu prakāśakastathāśiva | sṛṣṭiśvarī tato yojya prathamaṃ piṇḍarāṭ tataḥ
saṃsthitā paramārthena punarrakṣita tatpadam | akalātu kalākāśe kaśo kālakalanayā kalā
yena jñātena vai samyak khecaratvaṃ prapadyate | śūnyasya śūnyabhāvena nādarūpakalānvitā
sṛṣṭisthaṃ pañcamaṃ viddhi daśamaṃ taṃ viduḥ priye | saṃhārāṣṭaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ sṛṣṭiaṣṭamasaṃyutam
etāstu pūjayet tatra jātyahaṃkāravarjitaḥ | tatastu smu?*? māsyadvya nimnonnatavivarjitam
yatra garbhatrayodayaṃ mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | rākākārā kuhūrūpā kuhunākāśabhakṣakī
sṛṣṭicakrasya saṃsthānaṃ vidhinā śṛṇu īśvara | śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me devadeveśi sthiticakre tu yat kramam
etat te kathitaṃ vīra mantroddharaṃ paraṃ śubham | śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me tava vaktrābjād vidyā sarvārthasādhakī
parāparepadaṃ paścāt saraditke padaṃ tataḥ | kalākalepadaṃ yojya śūnyaśāntapadaṃ tataḥ
anulome pramānākhyāṃ kālaṃsaṃkarṣayet paraṃ | (?) kālasya sarvabhakṣasya hehaṃ vai kalāsaṃbhavam
saṃhāracakre deveśa trayodaśaṃ samuddharet | sṛṣṭidaśena saṃyuktaṃ aṣṭamena adhoyutam
namo'stu devi ādau ca madhye tubhyaṃ namo'stu te | etat stutipadaṃ kṛtvā tathedaṃ vākyamabravīt
sthitisthaṃ dvādaśamaṃ yad vai daśapaṃcamakaṃ viduḥ | sṛṣṭipañcamakaṃ yat tu saṃhārādaṣṭame yutam
ava idyātu deveśa vāgbhavaḥ tu rahasyagaḥ | nyastavyā sarvathā rudra ante vā sānukaṃpayā
tārayet sarvajantūnāṃ araṇḍa paśvaśca? sadā | praviṣṭasya praviṣṭā sā niryā *? gantugāminī
tithyante mārgārūḍhā sā ūrdhvamārgāvalambinī | tena mārgeṇa sā raśmiḥ śaktirūpā khamāgatā
eṣā śatākṣarā vidyā sthiticakrasya pūraṇe | samayā sarvathā nātha samadurvāritā satī
mukhapāraṃparāyātaṃ mukhapāraṃparojjhitam | mukhasāraṃ parāvasthāṃ ko naraḥ prāpyanāṣṇute
sṛṣṭiprathamagaṃ gṛhya saṃhārasyāṣṭamayutam | pañcamaṃ tad vijānīyād vidyā pañcākṣarā bhavet
melāpe militā sā vai viharet paramā citiḥ | (8) apānavāyumāśritya dvādaśānte nirākulā
nistaraṅge tadoddhṛtya pareti ca padaṃ tathā | parāparepadaṃ paścāt sarvadikya padaṃ tataḥ
